# Reactions

`jaff.core.Reactions`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Ordered, doubly-indexed catalogue of `Reaction` objects.

Reactions can be looked up by verbatim string (`reactions["H + H2O+ -> H2 + OH+"]`)
or by serialized form (`reactions["H_H2O+__H2_OH+"]`).

Both indexes map a key to a *list* of reactions: several reactions may
share a verbatim string or serialized form when they differ only by
mechanism/`type` (e.g. thermal vs cosmic-ray desorption).

## Constructor

`#!python Reactions(reactions=None)`

**Parameters**

**reactions** : _list[Reaction] | None, optional_
: Initial reactions.  If `None`, an empty catalogue is created.

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`add`](add.md) | Append a reaction to the catalogue (duplicates are not checked here). |
| [`by_source_index`](by_source_index.md) | Return the reaction whose file-side number (`source_index`) is *n*. |
| [`from_serialized`](from_serialized.md) | Return all reactions sharing a serialized form. |
| [`all`](all.md) | Return all reactions sharing *serialized* (empty if none). |
| [`from_verbatim`](from_verbatim.md) | Look up a reaction by its verbatim string. |
| [`get_list`](get_list.md) | Return the underlying ordered list of `Reaction` objects. |
| [`get`](get.md) | Look up a reaction by name or serialized form, with optional type filter. |
| [`with_type`](with_type.md) | Return all reactions matching the given reaction type. |
| [`with_format`](with_format.md) | Return all reactions produced by the named network-format parser. |
| [`verbatim`](verbatim.md) | Return a `Vector` of verbatim reaction strings. |
| [`types`](types.md) | Return a `Vector` of reaction type strings. |
| [`reactants`](reactants.md) | Return a `Vector` of reactant `Species` catalogues. |
| [`products`](products.md) | Return a `Vector` of product `Species` catalogues. |
| [`rate_coefficients`](rate_coefficients.md) | Return a `Vector` of rate-coefficient SymPy expressions. |
| [`rates`](rates.md) | Return a `Vector` of reaction rates, `rate_coefficient · Π nden`. |
| [`tmins`](tmins.md) | Return a `Vector` of lower temperature bounds (K or `None`). |
| [`tmaxes`](tmaxes.md) | Return a `Vector` of upper temperature bounds (K or `None`). |
| [`dE`](dE.md) | Return a `Vector` of energy-change SymPy expressions (erg). |
| [`serialized`](serialized.md) | Return a `Vector` of name-level serialized reaction strings. |
| [`serialized_exploded`](serialized_exploded.md) | Return a `Vector` of atom-level (isomer-insensitive) serialized strings. |
| [`radiation_emitters`](radiation_emitters.md) | Return all reactions that emit radiation (have a `spectralYield`). |
| [`photo_reactions`](photo_reactions.md) | Return all photo-reactions (`type == "photo"`). |
| [`photo_reaction_truths`](photo_reaction_truths.md) | Return a binary `Vector` marking photo-reactions with `1`. |
| [`photo_reaction_indices`](photo_reaction_indices.md) | Return the integer indices of photo-reactions within this catalogue. |
| [`plot_rates`](plot_rates.md) | Plot the rate coefficients of every reaction in the catalogue. |
| [`plot_xsecs`](plot_xsecs.md) | Plot the photo cross sections of the catalogue's reactions. |
